settings.question: What is FITNOVA?
settings.answer: FITNOVA is a fitness and lifestyle clothing brand built around movement, confidence, and everyday style. Our collections combine comfort, versatility, and modern design for both active and everyday moments.

settings.question: What type of clothing does FITNOVA offer?
settings.answer: Our collections include T-shirts, hoodies, loungewear, sweatshirts & pullovers, shorts, and other fitness and lifestyle apparel available in our store.

settings.question: Is FITNOVA clothing only for workouts?
settings.answer: No. FITNOVA combines fitness and lifestyle style, making our pieces suitable for active moments as well as casual everyday wear.

settings.question: What makes FITNOVA different?
settings.answer: FITNOVA brings fitness and everyday style together. Our brand focuses on versatile apparel with a modern aesthetic that fits naturally into an active lifestyle.

settings.question: How should I care for my FITNOVA clothing?
settings.answer: Always follow the care instructions provided with your specific garment. Proper care helps maintain the appearance, fit, and quality of your clothing over time.

settings.question: How can I discover FITNOVA’s different styles?
settings.answer: Explore our collections to browse T-shirts, hoodies, loungewear, sweatshirts & pullovers, shorts, and the other styles currently available.

settings.question: Where does FITNOVA ship?
settings.answer: Please check the sizing information provided on the product page before placing your order. Available sizes may vary depending on the product.

settings.question: Are all sizes and colors shown on the website available?
settings.answer: Available options are displayed directly on each product page. Select your preferred size or color to see the variants currently available.

settings.question: How can I place an order?
settings.answer: Choose your product, select the available options, add it to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Follow the checkout steps to enter your shipping and payment information and complete your purchase.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: All currently available payment methods are displayed securely during checkout. The options available may vary depending on your location.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: If you need to request a change or cancellation, please contact us as soon as possible after placing your order. We will review your request based on the current status of the order.

settings.question: How can I contact FITNOVA about my order?
settings.answer: You can reach us through our Contact page. If your question concerns an existing purchase, please include your order information and a clear description of your request so we can assist you efficiently.

settings.banner_subheading: Our customer service will be happy to help you.
